name: lasso-security
description: Deterministic cross-project dependency and supply-chain scanning for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Runs pinned local vulnerability scanners across workspace projects, normalizes scanner-agreement and IOC evidence, and retains append-only adjudication history while official Codex Security owns semantic source analysis.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $security-scan to collect deterministic dependency and IOC evidence for the requested workspace projects.
